description: Implementation of ICMPv6 packet creation for IPv6 network communication, including checksum calculation and packet assembly.

classes.name: ICMPv6Packet
classes.description: Structure representing an ICMPv6 packet with IPv6 header, ICMP header, and payload body.

classes.name: IPv6PseudoHeader
classes.description: Structure representing the pseudo-header used for checksum calculation in IPv6 ICMP packets.

methods.name: CreateIcmpPacket
methods.description: Creates an ICMPv6 packet with specified source and destination addresses, ICMP header, and body, then executes a callback with the packet data.
